prompt: How many ways can we place 8 books on a bookcase with 5 shelves if the books are (a) indistinguishable copies (b) all distinct? Note that the position of the books on the shelves does not matter. Note that all books may be placed on the same shelf.
judge_reasoning: The correct answers are (a) 495 via stars-and-bars and (b) 5^8 = 390625 because shelf positions matter but within-shelf order does not. Candidate [1] matches both parts exactly. Candidates [2] and [4] get (a) correct but give incorrect formulas for (b), while Candidate [3] gets (b) correct but has an incorrect result for (a). Thus [1] is the only fully correct response and ranks highest.
